target_definition: Lab-labelled leak vs no-leak window from accelerometer recordings.
training_dataset: Lab acoustic leak detection recordings (branched + looped topologies)
code_version_note: Trained via ai/leak_detection_model.py; regenerate with py ai/train.py
split_strategy: stratified file-level split (disjoint recording files) + no-leak noise augmentation on train only
split_method: stratified file-level split + no-leak noise augmentation

evaluation_period.note: Lab recording set; not a field DMA evaluation window.

majority_class_baseline.derived_from: test confusion_matrix counts (not a separate labelled run)

baseline_comparison.note: On this small held-out set the model F1 (0.8466) does not beat always-predict-leak F1 (0.8571). Treat as a lab pilot; field DMA validation is required.

volume_prediction.note: Classifier does not predict water volume. Any L/min figure is a disclosed orifice heuristic, not a learned label.

limitations: Trained on accelerometer lab recordings (branched and looped topologies).
No water-loss volume in training labels; volumetric estimates are not supported.
Lab-trained, not field-validated on DMA networks.
Small held-out population (96 windows); one misclassified file moves metrics noticeably.
